avis.titre: Highly Recommend - Product Leaves my Face Feeling Soft & Clean!Highly Recommend - Product Leaves my Face Feeling Soft &
avis.texte: I have really expensive face cleaner that I've been using for a long time now. But when I unfortunately lost my job and had to move back in with my parents, it got packed in God only knows what box, so I'm unable to use it. I was actually going online to buy another one when I decided to look for different brands on Amazon. This product, Clean & Clear, popped up immediately and I remembered that I used to use this back when I was in high school. This was the brand to use back in the day. And since it worked well for me back then, I decided to give it another try. I'm really glad I did because this works very well. And serious, $6.45 (that's including tax) for a 7oz tube/bottle is insanely cheap! After I use this product, my face is so soft. I love that feeling! It clears out my pores really well and other imperfections on my face and leaves my face feeling refreshed, clean, and visibly smooth. I personally only use this product at night, but once I start working again and get into a routine, I will use it in the morning before work and then at night when I get off work and get ready for bed. If you read the instructions (at least the online instructions, I haven't read the instructions on the tube/bottle itself), it says to, "Apply a moisturizer, such as Clean & Clear Essentials Dual Action Moisturizer to hydrate your skin and treat your acne". I currently don't have this product that they're suggesting, but I plan on buying it. I'm curious if I'll notice a difference. I migh

avis.titre: GREAT product but buyer beware of FALSE advertising
avis.texte: My family and I have been using this Clean and Clear facial cleanser for YEARS and love it!!! I’ve got teen kids and they all use it! All of the Clean and Clear products are fantastic! I absolutely LOVE Amazon and most of my friends and family tease me about “my little habit” LOL but I had to write this review because it has now happened TWICE!! So my 2-stars review is not for the product but the product delivery. The product which I bought was CLEARLY advertised as a 3-pack bundle for sale. It shows not only a visual with a picture BUT it also says “3-pack”!! Well, the past 2 times I tried to order it I’ve only received 1- 5 ounce facial cleanser!!! I’m not paying $16+ for a SINGLE 5 ounce Clean and Clear facial cleanser!!! Amazon being Amazon graciously refunded me after I returned the product. Now, I can pass this off as “an accident or oversight” IF it happened only once but that wasn’t the case! It happened again and within like 2 months!! I can’t help but feel as if this is “false advertising”!!! Don’t get me wrong I really appreciate Amazon’s amazing return policy BUT I’d really rather just be able to get what I’m paying for… ALL of it please.

avis.titre: “Decent Cleanser, But a Bit Drying for Sensitive Skin”
avis.texte: “The Clean & Clear Deep Action Cleansing Solution works decently for a quick refresh, but it doesn’t quite deliver the deep clean I was expecting. While it leaves my skin feeling cool and tingly, it can be a bit drying with regular use. It’s good for occasional use, but not ideal for sensitive skin. I wish it had a more hydrating formula to balance out the cleansing effects.”

I tried the new formula for a few weeks and now I’m breaking out and my skin is dry even with my moisturizing routine. The new one doesn’t have the cooling feel and the “moodscent tech” is just really accentuated fragrance. For my girls that run hot and love the cooling of the original formula, try the Neutrogena deep clean foaming scrub, the ingredients are alllllmost identical. I follow the scrub with the Neutrogena cream cleanser, leave it on for a few minutes and rinse off with cool water for a refreshing clean. The neutrogena foaming scrub doesn’t *quite* match up to the original clean and clear scrub but it’s close. Disappointed to have to find a new go to, but nothing is promised forever I guess☹️

avis.titre: I have pretty oily skin that is sensitive and prone to break ...
avis.texte: I have pretty oily skin that is sensitive and prone to break outs, especially in my chin and forehead area. I have been using this face wash for a week and am pleased so far. First of all the product is a nice size bottle I expect to last for awhile. It is easy to dispense the right amount. It says it cleans deep down to the pore and can remove makeup, I haven't used it to remove makeup but seems like it probably would work well. On the back it states it does not contain plastic microbeads (I don't think any products are allowed to contain them anymore). Whoever found the substitute for the microbeads did a great job because I can't tell a difference. This product does feel like it contains an exfoliating microbead of some sort in it. The beads (or whatever they are technically called) leave my skin feeling fresh. They also make it a little hard to use this product in the sink, it is much easier to rinse it all off in the shower. I haven't had any break outs at all and it hasn't overly dried my skin either. It leaves my face very clean and fresh feeling. Overall pleased and will continue to use this.

avis.titre: The cap near the "living hinge" simply fell apart after about a dozen uses
avis.texte: The cap near the "living hinge" simply fell apart after about 3 months of sitting on the bathroom counter and maybe a dozen uses.... Now, the product is unusable. As an exfoliating face cleaner it's very mild.... It doesn't really give that satisfying scrub experience that I get from using the similar "Bulldog" or "Doctor Squatch" product. That being said I have begun to use it is kind of an upper body wash and sometimes for between the toes cleaning. On the plus side, there is no heavy perfumey smell and it seems to rinse quite cleanly with warm water. Unfortunately I only got to use less than an ounce of the 7 oz in the tube. I'm pretty disappointed, Honestly, I very likely would not have ordered it again but I feel a bit cheated I didn't get to use what I did buy But now I don't know what to do with it, it's too late to try to get a refund
